label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Region and painted downloads up to 30,000 image tiles (was 2,000 and 20,000). Downloaded files are committed 48 per transaction; downloads pace themselves to under 900 network requests a minute (all of the app's requests, under LINZ's standard-key limit) and on HTTP 429 pause 30 s doubling to 5 min and retry the same tile (up to 6 times).

Hold to paint: the map moves normally; press and hold 280 ms without moving (with a haptic tick), then drag, to paint or erase. A second finger keeps the stroke and moves the map. The Move/Paint switch is gone. A short note at the top of the map, styled like the map status, says how to paint when the bar opens and when a colour or Erase is chosen.

Fixed: the region frame (and the brush outline) were drawn underneath the map since 0.1.37 (the map is inside a container, so its index in the root was -1), so no box appeared. Both are now added just under the offline bar.
Offline bar simplified: Advanced and Saved regions removed. Painted downloads use the imagery shown on the map, with NZ Topo and overlays. Overview imagery ZIPs moved to Layers > Advanced.

Saved regions are listed in the routes drawer under the saved routes: an overview image (the region's imagery from its own tiles, with painted cells or the region outline), name, type and detail, status and size, with View, Resume, Rename and Delete.

tests.kotlinJvm: 209 tests, 0 failures (one run hit PlaceSearch's 150 ms timing limit at 156 ms while the machine was busy; the rerun passed)
